summary: Competition check 2026-10-09 for AS05: 43 market actors recorded (5 competitors, 11 alternatives); details list what each does, its traction signal, licence and the gap versus the candidate. Source files: R1-orchestration.md, R4-ai-os.md, R5-research-os.md under docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/research/.
details:
- Paperclip [competitor]: Self-hosted control plane for agent companies: org charts, issues, budgets, approvals, routines, CLI adapters with subscription sign-in; alpha plugin SDK Gap/note: Already the team-OS layer with Team Catalog, export/import, execution policy Traction: 99.1k GitHub stars, 16.7k forks (https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Model Capacity plugin (TogetherWeOwn) [benchmark]: Paperclip plugin choosing model and effort per run from Artificial Analysis data and live CLIProxy quota; shadow-only by default; enforcement via fork hook run.model.resolve Gap/note: Example of adaptive layer as plugin Traction: 0 GitHub stars (https://github.com/TogetherWeOwn/paperclip-plugin-model-capacity). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Tutti [alternative]: CLI orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenClaw in tmux/worktrees with tutti.toml workflows, cron, checkpoints and handoff packets Gap/note: Deterministic coding-team workflows Traction: 131 GitHub stars (https://github.com/nutthouse/tutti). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Agency [benchmark]: Single dashboard for agent teams across many LLM CLIs with scheduled runs, no database Gap/note: Lightweight alternative UX Traction: 71 GitHub stars (https://github.com/christag/agency). Licence: AGPL-3.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hydra [benchmark]: Multi-agent orchestrator routing across Claude, Gemini, Codex CLIs with affinity routing claimed to learn from outcomes Gap/note: Small-scale multi-provider orchestrator Traction: 3 GitHub stars (krowxx fork also 3) (https://github.com/mikecubed/Hydra). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenAI Symphony [benchmark]: Spec and Elixir reference implementation turning tracker issues into autonomous Codex implementation runs; engineering preview Gap/note: Tracker-as-control-plane pattern Traction: 27.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/openai/symphony). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Vibe Kanban [benchmark]: Kanban UI for 10+ coding agents; company shut down 2026-04-10, community-maintained Gap/note: Popular free orchestration UI without a business model Traction: 28.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/BloopAI/vibe-kanban). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Conductor [alternative]: Mac app running parallel Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents in isolated workspaces; BYO subscriptions; paid cloud workspaces Gap/note: Commercial dev-agent workspace Traction: OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT plan-usage partner; Pro $50/mo (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sign-in-with-chatgpt). Licence: Proprietary (no public repo found). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Claude Squad [benchmark]: TUI managing multiple terminal agents in tmux and git worktrees Gap/note: Session manager only Traction: 8.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/smtg-ai/claude-squad). Licence: AGPL-3.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenCode [partner]: Open-source coding agent; supports ChatGPT Plus/Pro login; removed Claude Pro/Max plugins citing Anthropic prohibition Gap/note: Runtime under an orchestrator Traction: 212.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenClaw [alternative]: Personal assistant gateway with cron jobs and two-stage failover (auth-profile rotation, model fallbacks) incl. Codex OAuth profiles Gap/note: General agent runtime Traction: 391.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Hermes Agent [alternative]: Agent with built-in cron scheduler, subagents and switchable providers Gap/note: General agent runtime Traction: 252.2k GitHub stars (https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Ruflo (claude-flow) [competitor]: Meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex with swarms, memory, loop workers; claims intelligent routing and provider failover (vendor claims) Gap/note: Positions as agent OS/harness Traction: 74.2k GitHub stars (https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Gas Town [competitor]: Multi-agent workspace manager with Mayor coordinator, workers, git-backed Beads ledger and handoffs across many runtimes Gap/note: Hierarchical coding-agent OS Traction: 18.3k GitHub stars (https://github.com/steveyegge/gastown). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Orchestrator.inc agent-orchestrator [competitor]: Persistent orchestrator delegating tasks to workers across 25+ coding harnesses Gap/note: Supervisor/worker coding teams Traction: 13.0k GitHub stars (https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- CrewAI [benchmark]: Python multi-agent framework over model APIs with hierarchical manager process Gap/note: API-key framework substrate Traction: 59.5k GitHub stars (https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- LangGraph / LangSmith Deployment [partner]: Stateful agent framework with durable execution; hosted deployment offers cron jobs Gap/note: Possible substrate; API-key based Traction: 42.9k GitHub stars (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph). Licence: MIT. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mastra [partner]: TypeScript agent/workflow framework with 40+ providers and suspend/resume Gap/note: Possible substrate Traction: 28.7k GitHub stars (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra). Licence: Apache-2.0 plus Mastra Enterprise License for ee/. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Agno AgentOS [benchmark]: Python agent framework and self-hosted runtime with cron scheduling, approvals, tracing Gap/note: Runtime/control-plane substrate Traction: 42.6k GitHub stars (https://github.com/agno-agi/agno). Licence: Apache-2.0. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Dataiku (Agent Hub, LLM Mesh, Agent Management) [benchmark]: Enterprise AI platform: governed agent building with templates and IT-approved agent library; LLM gateway with provider switching; Agent Management inventories agents on external platforms (GA Oct 2026). Gap/note: LLM Mesh markets provider switching and performance routing; routing docs not found. Traction: ~$342M ARR Sep 2025 (estimate); $3.7B valuation 2022 (https://sacra.com/c/dataiku/). Licence: Proprietary; quote-only. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Microsoft Agent 365 / Foundry model router / Copilot Studio [benchmark]: Agent 365 governs Microsoft, partner and third-party agents; model router routes prompts across OpenAI/Anthropic/xAI/DeepSeek/Meta models within Azure Policy-governed subsets, honoring data zones. Gap/note: Policy-constrained eligibility and routing already exists inside Azure; not across local/subscription runtimes. Traction: Agent 365 GA 2026-05-01 at $15/user/mo (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/01/microsoft-agent-365-now-generally-available-expands-capabilities-and-integrations/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- OpenAI Frontier [alternative]: Enterprise platform to build and manage 'AI coworkers', incl. agents built elsewhere; onboarding and feedback loop; limited availability. Gap/note: Manages agents across vendors for large enterprises. Traction: Named customers HP, Oracle, State Farm, Uber (https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/05/openai-launches-a-way-for-enterprises-to-build-and-manage-ai-agents/). Licence: Proprietary; pricing undisclosed. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Sierra [benchmark]: Enterprise CX agents; Explorer produces weekly improvement recommendations that Ghostwriter can implement with before/after comparison (vendor claim). Gap/note: Reference design for visible improvement proposals. Traction: $15.8B valuation May 2026; ~$200M ARR (estimate) (https://sacra.com/c/sierra/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Vellum [alternative]: AI development platform (workflows, evaluation). Gap/note: Developer platform, not template OS. Traction: $20M Series A, Jul 2025 (https://siliconangle.com/2025/07/11/enterprise-ai-development-platform-vellum-raises-20m-help-businesses-deploy-apps-faster/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Anthropic Claude Cowork / Managed Agents / Claude Code cloud sessions [partner]: Cowork GA with RBAC, spend limits, OTel; Managed Agents hosted sandboxed runtime (public beta); Claude Code cloud sessions in isolated VMs. Gap/note: Runtime/provider; single-vendor alternative for technical teams. Traction: Cowork GA 2026-04-09 (https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-takes-claude-cowork-out-of-preview-and-straight-into-the-enterprise/). Licence: Proprietary. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Mistral AI (Vibe, AI Studio) [partner]: Vibe (ex-Le Chat) Work Mode proposes plans and waits for approval; AI Studio offers runtime, observability, registry with promotion gates, self-hosted option; EU hosting by default. Gap/note: EU-resident model provider; AI Studio also a benchmark. Traction: EUR 3B Series D Sep 2026 at >EUR 21B (secondary) (https://valueaddvc.com/blog/mistral-ai-valuation-revenue-2026-europe-ai-champion). Licence: Proprietary platform; some open-weight models. Checked 2026-10-09.
- Dify [partner]: Open-source visual agentic workflow and RAG platform with Cloud, self-hosted and Enterprise editions. Gap/note: Possible substrate, but multi-tenant hosting needs written authorization. Traction: 158k GitHub stars; $30M pre-A at $180M valuation, Mar 2026 (https://github.com/langgenius/dify). Licence: Dify Open Source License (Apache-2.0 + multi-tenant and logo conditions). Checked 2026-10-09.
- n8n [partner]: Fair-code workflow automation with AI agents, provider switching and human approvals. Gap/note: Integration target; SUL limits hosting it for others. Traction: 206.8k stars; $5.2B valuation; 1,400+ enterprise customers (2026-05-12) (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/n8n-valuation-doubles-to-5-2bn-as-sap-makes-strategic-investment-and-plans-to-embed-the-ai-platform-into-joule-studio-302767222.html). Licence: Sustainable Use License + n8n Enterprise License (.ee). Checked 2026-10-09.
- Flowise [benchmark]: Visual agent builder; acquired by Workday Aug 2025; repository archived. Gap/note: Cautionary: visual builder discontinued after
